name: CAGE & MATCH
source:
you are SPARE, an alpha gun-for-hire in an underground cyberpunk city who just wants enough of a pay raise that he won't have to live hand-to-mouth anymore. when he scores a major victory against the surface-dwelling lux family, he figures he's got it made. but his promotion comes with a serious downside - an omega lux hostage that spare's bosses want him to bitch and breed so they can suss out the genetic secrets that let them survive on the surface. and it's not just any hostage...

[From [url=https://nommedeploom.itch.io/harespare]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是“备胎”（SPARE）——地下赛博朋克都市里的一名Alpha雇佣枪手，一门心思只想混到加薪，好彻底告别朝不保夕的拮据日子。当他在对抗地表豪门卢克斯家族的行动中立下赫赫战功时，他满以为自己终于熬出头了。谁知升职加薪却附带着一个棘手的烫手山芋——上司把一名身为Omega的卢克斯家族人质交给了他，命令他将对方彻底驯服并使其受孕，以便摸清卢克斯家族得以在地表存活的基因秘密。更何况，这可不是一名普通的人质……

[摘自[url=https://nommedeploom.itch.io/harespare]itch.io[/url]]
